title: Verify: BootScene characterClick emission unit tests with Phaser mocked
summary: Unit-test that clicking an NPC sprite emits characterClick and still plays interact.
description: Extend bootSceneCharacters tests, which already mock phaser and content, to spy on phaserToReact.emit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the mocked scene, When pointerdown runs on the boy sprite, Then phaserToReact.emit is called with 'characterClick' and { id: 'boy' }.
Given the same click, When handled, Then sprite.play is called with the interact key.
technical_constraints: Reuse the existing vi.mock('phaser') and content mock and the pointerDownOn helper

steps.symbol: new: it('emits characterClick with the spec id and still plays interact on pointerdown')
steps.action: Import phaserToReact from '../src/phaser/events'. Create BootScene, set its readState as existing tests do, call create(), take the first value returned by scene.add.sprite, get its listener via pointerDownOn, vi.spyOn(phaserToReact, 'emit'), invoke the listener, then assert emit was called with ('characterClick', { id: 'boy' }) and sprite.play was called with the interact key.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts
steps.expected: bootSceneCharacters suite passes including the new emit test.
